_description: Test fixture: Phase 7 underway. current_sprint.status still says 'executing' ON PURPOSE -- this is the common real-world case, since sprint_status.json is refreshed at Phase 7.7 rather than continuously. It proves Gate 1c's retrospective-file fallback (b) works even when the status marker (a) has not caught up. The status file must still name Sprint 51 as CURRENT, otherwise a historical retrospective would exempt the branch (see violation-4).
